asked: # Build: finish the veto system (Refactor profile, Opus, one session, no sub-agents) NOTE (relaunch Oct 30 2026 13:55 EDT): the first launch stopped because it could not load the rules from axHub. This launch is allowed the axHub tool (mcp__claude_ai_axHub__call, list_services, describe_service, get_job): load CLAUDE.md, the shared rules and THREADS.md through axhub.memory_read (project amberx-axf / shared, area claude), then build. The axHub tool is allowed. Relaunch Oct 30 2026: the first launch failed at once (claude refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions as root), so nothing was built. Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md, _claude/rules/RULES.md and _claude/THREADS.md first. Work on branch claude/veto-complete (this worktree). axHub lives at MossesX/axHub: clone it next to this worktree; its open PR #19 (claude/veto-everywhere, decision #103: every confirm call held on the veto countdown, AXHUB_CONFIRM_AS default veto) is the base for axHub work — build on that branch. AXF PRs #176 (claude/veto-everywhere: shared rules) and #177 (feat/agent-voice) are open; merge main or #176 in if you touch the same files. Brett asked (voice, Oct 30 2026): 1. Veto everywhere, countdown 90 seconds (not 180): change the hub default and the live services (vps.run, vps.logs and everything decision #103 turns into veto). Live hub CLI: ~/hub/bin/axhub services veto <ns> <tool> 90 <warning>; also make 90 the default for #103 calls. 2. The veto notices, Deny screen and alarm belong to the veto banner plugin (the approvals banner console plugin that already shows held calls with a countdown + Deny), so they work in any app it is installed in. Install that banner plugin into AmberX (target amberx-droid; AmberX web loads it, the phone app shows the web app). Keep it in the console too. 3. A configurable alarm in that banner plugin's settings: on/off, tone (built-in list + his own sound file), volume, gets louder over time, how long it rings, repeat, vibration pattern, when in the countdown it starts, ring through silent mode (needs a small native piece in AmberX Android: apps/amberx-droid, alarm audio stream; the banner's settings control it). 4. Tapping any veto notification on the phone (held, 30 s warning, running) opens a screen with the countdown and Deny, Approve and Shelve; the notification itself also carries Deny / Approve / Shelve action buttons. 5. Approve = run it right away (skip the rest of the countdown, no more notices for that call). Shelve = pause the countdown; the call waits until he approves or denies it. Both need axHub support (new actions next to Deny in the hub core + /auth/api/approvals/<id>/approve-now and /shelve, CLI, feeds, push phases; same admin session + Origin + CSRF + compare-and-set + audit rules as Deny; the AI client can never approve, hurry or shelve). Add tests. 6. Remove or mark done anything still queued that clashes (old veto-window build, approval-only GitHub write tools, the approve-everything item is already removed) and keep _claude/THREADS.md + the Refactor orchestrator (_claude/builds/profiles/refactor/orchestrator.json, build veto-everywhere) current. Rules for this build: never poll or re-check veto calls; anything that needs Brett goes out as a veto call with a reason (title + description). Run the tests (axHub: pnpm test; AXF: the plugin self-tests, console tsc, AmberX tsc + test.mjs, check-theme, check-controls) and push your branches; open PRs through the console push banner. Don't merge.
